name: max_files_per_process
description: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously open files (file descriptors) allowed for each PostgreSQL server process.
symptoms: Process crashes due to file descriptor exhaustion
Inability to open relations or WAL files
tuning_tips: Set this value slightly below the OS per-process file descriptor limit (ulimit -n); increase only if encountering 'Too many open files' errors and the OS limit allows it. Decrease if processes fail to start or exhibit instability due to resource contention.
